lessons.correction: Continue developing your economy and tech, and prepare to build a ground army.
lessons.mistake: Over-committing to defense at the expense of economy, or neglecting scouting for tech switches or all-ins.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have more information about the opponent's build or when you are ready to expand.
lessons.title: Avoid over-defending early
lessons.when: Early game, around 180 seconds, with heavy economy and tech investment, moderate production, and opponent showing ground posture with Marines/Marauders.
lessons.why: Early game is about establishing a strong economy and tech base to support future production.

lessons.correction: Continue developing your economy and tech, strengthen your ground army, and maintain defensive readiness.
lessons.mistake: Neglecting air defense, as the opponent may transition to air later, or over-extending your army without proper scouting.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have a clear read on the opponent's tech or army composition, or when you are ready to transition to a more specialized composition.
lessons.title: Avoid neglecting air defense
lessons.when: Early-midgame, around 240-360 seconds, with heavy economy and tech investment, moderate production, and opponent showing ground posture with possible early pressure.
lessons.why: This phase rewards economic and tech growth while staying safe against potential early pressure. A strong ground core with Sentry support provides defensive options.

lessons.correction: Continue developing your economy and tech, and prepare to defend against early Reaper harassment.
lessons.mistake: Making assumptions about the enemy's build without scouting, or neglecting defense while teching.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have a clearer picture of the opponent's follow-up.
lessons.title: Avoid assuming enemy build without scouting
lessons.when: Early game, around 180 seconds, with heavy economy and tech investment, moderate production, and opponent showing possible Reaper opening.
lessons.why: Reapers can harass early, so defensive positioning and scouting are important.
